extension.summary: 雾汐｜Kodi 22 轻量透明皮肤，需 Mistuary Helper；搭配 Emby for Kodi NextGen 可自动同步媒体库
Lightweight transparent skin for Kodi 22, requires Mistuary Helper; syncs your Emby library with Emby for Kodi NextGen
extension.description:
基于 Estuary N 改造的小而美皮肤，需要 Kodi 22 及以上。 依赖插件 Mistuary Helper，请先安装插件再切换皮肤。
搭配 Emby for Kodi NextGen 并登录后，媒体库会直接同步到 Kodi： 电影、剧集、季、集、评分与媒体库封面开箱即用，不需要手动整理或额外配置。
Mistuary Helper 提供：服务端中文搜索、详情页豆瓣评分、媒体库封面同步、 播放列表补全（按季 / 按目录 / 跨季），以及文件播放记录 —— 只在文件管理器（10003）里生效，播过的视频会记住进度，下次起播可选择「继续播放」， 焦点行还有圆环显示已播比例；不改动 Kodi 原生续播点。
详情页评分支持 TMDb / IMDb / 豆瓣 / 烂番茄（同时最多两个）， 技术标识按分辨率 / HDR / 杜比视界档位 / 编码 / 声道图标化。 电视剧季视图直接呈现剧集详情版式：季标签与本季集卡片同屏，所有电视剧入口一致。 透黑、透白双主题，页面 / 浮窗 / 播放中三档透明度各 6 级可调； 8 套屏幕比例自适应（16:9 / 18:9 / 21:9 等），另有音乐黑胶模式与电源菜单。

A compact, polished skin built on Estuary N. Requires Kodi 22 or newer. Requires the Mistuary Helper add-on - install it before switching skins.
With Emby for Kodi NextGen installed and signed in, your media library syncs directly into Kodi: movies, shows, seasons, episodes, ratings and library covers work out of the box without manual setup.
Mistuary Helper provides server-side Chinese search, Douban ratings in the video info dialog, media-library cover sync, playlist completion (by season / by folder / next season), and file playback resume - only for the file manager (10003): videos remember their position, offer “resume from h:mm:ss” on the next start, and show a progress ring on the focused row. Kodi's native resume points are not touched.
Ratings from TMDb / IMDb / Douban / Rotten Tomatoes (up to two at a time); technical flags are shown as icons (resolution, HDR, Dolby Vision profile, codecs, channels). TV seasons open in a detail-style page with season tabs and the current season's episode cards on one screen, consistently from every library entry. Dark and light transparent themes with six levels each for pages, popups and playback; eight aspect ratios supported, plus a vinyl mode and a power menu.
extension.disclaimer: Weather, radio and game browsing surfaces are intentionally omitted.
本皮肤有意省略天气、电台和游戏浏览界面。
